Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly requested diversifying searches (including Britannica and other authoritative sources) to confirm Huernia’s genus status, WebSurfer repeatedly ran the same POWO site-restricted queries and did not pivot to the requested alternative sources or extract a clear genus-level citation. This repetitive, non-adaptive behavior stalled progress and prevented synthesizing the straightforward conclusion that both Dictyosperma and Huernia are genera.
